summary_1line: Ignoring ominous signs and counsel to make peace, Ravana angrily rejects Malyavan’s warning and organizes Lanka’s defenses against Rama’s approaching forces.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana, scowling and eyes blazing with anger, sits on his throne while the aged Malyavan stands before him warning of terrible omens.
Strange omens fill Lanka: dogs devour sacred offerings while red-footed white pigeons circle ominously above the city.
Ravana commands his generals as Lanka’s massive gates are assigned to demon warriors and Indrajit prepares forces at the western gate.
